summary: This joint resolution nullifies the Bureau of Land Management rule (88 Fed. Reg. 6308) that withdrew federal lands in Cook, Lake, and Saint Louis Counties, Minnesota, from mineral and geothermal leasing.

scores.thoughts: The bill is a Congressional Review Act resolution nullifying a specific BLM land withdrawal rule. It contains no provisions related to federal budgets, appropriations, or expenditures.
No tax provisions, rate changes, or revenue measures appear in the bill text.
The legislation addresses federal land management and has no connection to healthcare policy, insurance, or medical services.
No references to firearms, regulations, or Second Amendment issues.
The bill concerns domestic land-use rules and does not address immigration, borders, or visas.
No content related to reproductive rights or abortion access.
No military, defense, or national security spending provisions.

The underlying BLM rule withdraws federal lands in Minnesota from mineral entry and other uses, functioning as an environmental protection measure. By disapproving the rule and rendering it void, the bill removes that protection and thereby limits environmental regulation on those lands.
